SELECT
      l_returnflag,
      l_linestatus,
      SUM(l_quantity) AS sum_qty,
      SUM(l_extendedprice) AS sum_base_price,
      SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS sum_disc_price,
      SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax)) AS sum_charge,
      AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_qty,
      AVG(l_extendedprice) AS avg_price,
      AVG(l_discount) AS avg_disc,
      COUNT(*) AS count_order
    FROM
      lineitem
    WHERE
      l_receiptdate <= '1998-09-02'
    GROUP BY
      l_returnflag,
      l_linestatus
    ORDER BY
      l_returnflag,
      l_linestatus

SELECT
    s.s_acctbal,
    s.s_name,
    n.n_name,
    p.p_partkey,
    p.p_mfgr,
    s.s_address,
    s.s_phone,
    s.s_comment
FROM partsupp ps
JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
JOIN (
    SELECT ps_partkey, MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_cost
    FROM partsupp
    JOIN part ON partsupp.ps_partkey = part.p_partkey
    GROUP BY ps_partkey
) min_calc ON ps.ps_partkey = min_calc.ps_partkey
WHERE
    p.p_size = 15
    AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS%'
    AND r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
    AND ps.ps_supplycost = min_calc.min_cost
ORDER BY
    s.s_acctbal DESC,

    s.s_name,
    COUNT(*) AS numwait
FROM supplier s
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN orders o ON s.s_suppkey = o.o_custkey
JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
WHERE n.n_name = 'SAUDI ARABIA'
    AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F'
    AND l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate
GROUP BY s.s_name, l.l_suppkey, l.l_orderkey
HAVING 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) 
     FROM lineitem l2 
     JOIN orders o2 ON l2.l_orderkey = o2.o_orderkey 
     JOIN lineitem l3 ON o2.o_orderkey = l3.l_orderkey 
     WHERE o2.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey 
       AND l2.l_suppkey != l.l_suppkey 
       AND l2.l_receiptdate > l2.l_commitdate) > 0
ORDER BY numwait DESC, s.s_name ASC
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  p.p_brand,
  p.p_type,
  p.p_size,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_cnt
FROM part p
JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
WHERE
  p.p_brand <> 'Brand#45'
  AND p.p_type NOT LIKE 'MEDIUM POLISHED'
  AND p.p_size IN (49, 14, 23, 45, 19, 3, 36, 9)
  AND s.s_comment NOT LIKE '%Customer%Complaints%'
  AND s.s_acctbal > 0
GROUP BY
  p.p_brand,
  p.p_type,
  p.p_size
ORDER BY
  supplier_cnt DESC,
  p.p_brand ASC,
  p.p_type ASC,
  p.p_size ASC

SELECT 
  n.n_name AS nation,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) AS o_year,
  SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) - ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS sum_profit
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
WHERE p.p_name LIKE '%green%'
GROUP BY n.n_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate)
ORDER BY n.n_name ASC, o_year DESC

WITH GlobalMinCost AS (

        ps.ps_partkey,
        MIN(ps.ps_supplycost) AS min_cost
    FROM partsupp ps
    JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
    WHERE p.p_size = 15 AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS%'
    GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey
)
SELECT
    s.s_acctbal,
    s.s_name,
    n.n_name,
    p.p_partkey,
    p.p_mfgr,
    s.s_address,
    s.s_phone,
    s.s_comment
FROM partsupp ps
JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
JOIN GlobalMinCost g ON ps.ps_partkey = g.ps_partkey
WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
  AND p.p_size = 15
  AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS%'
  AND ps.ps_supplycost = g.min_cost
ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC, n.n_name, s.s_name, p.p_partkey

WITH total_stock_value AS (
    SELECT SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) AS total_value
    FROM partsupp
)
SELECT
    ps.ps_partkey,
    SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS value
FROM partsupp ps
JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
WHERE n.n_name = 'GERMANY'
GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey
HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 0.0001 * (SELECT total_value FROM total_stock_value)
ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT
    l.l_shipmode,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' OR o.o_orderpriority = '2-HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_line_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority != '1-URGENT' AND o.o_orderpriority != '2-HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_line_count
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
WHERE
    l.l_shipmode IN ('MAIL', 'SHIP')
    AND l.l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1995-01-01'
    AND l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate
    AND l.l_shipdate < l.l_commitdate
GROUP BY l.l_shipmode
ORDER BY l.l_shipmode

WITH country_code_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    substr(c.c_phone, 1, 2) AS cntrycode,
    AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS avg_balance
  FROM customer c
  JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
  WHERE c.c_phone LIKE '%13%' OR c.c_phone LIKE '%31%' 
    OR c.c_phone LIKE '%23%' OR c.c_phone LIKE '%29%' 
    OR c.c_phone LIKE '%30%' OR c.c_phone LIKE '%18%' OR c.c_phone LIKE '%17%'
  GROUP BY cntrycode
)
SELECT 
  cc.cntrycode,
  COUNT(*) AS numcust,
  SUM(c.c_acctbal) AS totacctbal

    o.o_orderdate,
    o.o_shippriority
FROM
    orders o

    JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
WHERE

        SELECT 1
        FROM lineitem l2
        WHERE l2.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey

    )
GROUP BY
    l.l_orderkey,
    o.o_orderdate,
    o.o_shippriority
ORDER BY
    revenue DESC,
    o.o_orderdate
LIMIT 10;

WITH part_avg_qty AS (
  SELECT l_partkey, AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_qty
  FROM lineitem
  GROUP BY l_partkey

SELECT
  SUM(l.l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly

JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN part_avg_qty pa ON l.l_partkey = pa.l_partkey

SELECT
    n.n_name,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM
    nation n
JOIN
    region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
JOIN
    supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
JOIN
    lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
JOIN
    orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
WHERE
    r.r_name = 'ASIA'
    AND o.o_orderdate >= '1994-01-01'
    AND o.o_orderdate < '1995-01-01'
GROUP BY
    n.n_name
ORDER BY
    revenue DESC
